title: 169th Maintenance Group Egress Highlight Video
description: U.S. Air Force Staff Sgt. Steven Curry and Senior Airman Alicia Cruz, both assigned to the 169th Maintenance Group as egress system technicians, explain the importance of their career field and how they contribute to the 169th Fighter Wing mission at McEntire Joint National Guard Base, South Carolina Air National Guard, April 14, 2023. The goal of Egress is to maintain the pilot’s safety in the event of aircraft ejection. (U.S. Air National Guard video by Airmen 1st Class Danielle Dawson)
keywords: McEntire JNGB, Swamp Fox, SCANG, 169th MXS, 169th MXG, F-16, egress
